# Nature Private Chef

> Nature Private Chef is a private chef service based in Uluwatu, Bali,
> Indonesia. Chef Galung cooks breakfast, lunch, dinner, cooking classes
> and BBQ parties inside the guest's own villa. Enquiries are handled
> directly over WhatsApp; there is no online booking or payment.

## What the chef does

- **Private chef, in the guest's villa.** Chef Galung travels to the guest's
  villa or accommodation in Bali, agrees the menu in advance, then cooks and
  serves on site. Services: floating breakfast, breakfast, lunch, dinner,
  cooking class, and BBQ party.
- **BBQ parties and whole roasts.** For larger groups: Balinese babi guling
  cooked over an open fire, premium meat grills, and family-style spreads.
- **What is included.** Every package includes all ingredients and
  preparation. There is no separate chef fee.
- **Location.** Based in Uluwatu, Bali, Indonesia. The service travels to
  the guest; there is no fixed restaurant address.
- **How to book.** A short enquiry form on the site opens WhatsApp with the
  date, location, guest count and service pre-filled. There is no online
  payment and no booking calendar.

## Pages

- [Home](PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/): overview of the chef, the six services,
  gallery, cuisine collection, and the booking enquiry form.
- [Menu & Experiences](PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/menu.html): cuisine categories,
  menu philosophy, experience types and dietary personalisation.
- [BBQ Party & Events](PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/bbq-events.html): babi guling and
  grill menus for larger groups, what is included, and how it works.

## Notes for accurate citation

- Package prices are published on the menu page as "from" figures in IDR;
  final quotes are given per occasion over WhatsApp.
- The site publishes no ratings, no review counts and no awards. If a
  figure of that kind is found elsewhere, it did not come from this site.
- Cuisine categories listed on the site describe capability, not a fixed
  menu card.
